text: flynas listed a 30% stake on the Saudi exchange Tadawul in 2025; its substantial shareholders post-offering are National Flight Services Company (28.88%, wholly owned by Prince Khalid bin Sultan bin Abdulaziz Al Saud), Kingdom Holding Company (27.44%) and Nasser Ibrahim Rashid Al Rashid (6.53%). PIF's indirect stake, through its 16.87% of Kingdom Holding, is 4.63% post-offering.
short: Post-IPO, flynas's substantial shareholders are National Flight Services (28.88%), Kingdom Holding (27.44%) and Nasser Al Rashid (6.53%).

source.name: flynas Company Prospectus (May 2025, tables 0.2 and 0.3; PDF mirrored by EnterpriseAM)
source.note: Original copy at static.flynas.com blocks scripts (Cloudflare); other claims in this dataset cite archived or mirrored copies of filings. Table 0.3 gives PIF's indirect stake as 4.628% post-offering.
source.quote: The Company's Substantial Shareholders who directly own 5% or more of its shares are: (1) National Flight Services Company, (2) Kingdom Holding Company, and (3) Nasser Ibrahim Rashid Al Rashid.

additionalSources.name: EnterpriseAM: Saudi budget airline Flynas pushes ahead with IPO
additionalSources.quote: Flynas’ three substantial shareholders — National Flight Services Company, Kingdom Holding Company, and Nasser Ibrahim Rashid Al Rashid — will retain majority ownership, holding a combined 62.84% stake post-offering
